how_to_pay: v2 routes (/v2/*, x402 v2 only): 1. POST → HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (accepts[]) · 2. Sign EIP-3009 USDC authorization on Base (eip155:8453) · 3. Retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (X-PAYMENT is not accepted on /v2) · 4. Success response carries the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header with the on-chain TX hash

legacy v1 routes (/x402/{product}/mcp/): 1. POST to receive structured 402 response with pricing · 2. Send USDC on Base network to payTo address (payment verified on confirmation) · 3. Retry call with X-PAYMENT: 0x{transaction_hash} header · 4. Tool executes, response includes X-Amount-Charged-USD and X-Balance-Remaining

v1_legacy.note: Existing v1 stack — wallet-based deposit (per-call USDC), see /x402/catalog.json

endpoints.name: UVO Quick — Agent Action Validator

input.proposal: {action_type, target, claim, expected_outcome, success_metric, args, idempotent, declared_sandbox}

Up to nine validation stages (IDs L0-L6, L8, L9 - historically non-contiguous; there is no L7), executed fail-fast: a blocking stage ends the run. Returns APPROVE/WARN/ESCALATE/BLOCK, risk score and per-stage reasoning. Sub-100ms validation time; transport not included.

endpoints.description: Deterministic validation of an agent action proposal. x402Pay.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402Pay.description: x402 v2 pay-per-call for /v2/* routes (Base USDC, EIP-3009 exact scheme). Challenge: HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; settlement receipt in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. LIVE — inbound payment verified before delivery; settled on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Legacy /x402/{product}/mcp/ routes use X-PAYMENT (see payment.v1_legacy).

outbound.note: NOMOS receives payments; it does NOT autonomously spend, transfer or sign. Outbound spend-locks remain closed and operator-gated.

x402_products.status: live — products are priced and the HTTP 402 paywall + Base-mainnet USDC settlement (eip155:8453) are enabled; backend delivery occurs after verified payment. Outbound autonomous spending by NOMOS is disabled (operator-gated). Best-effort availability; no uptime guarantee.
